blockers: All 6 remaining sorries share root blocker: nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses tries to build 2-var agreement from 1-var agreements + zone3_witnesses, but non-between zones and zone3_from_bracket quantifiers need multi-var agreement at the same or lower depth, creating circularity. Resolution: (a) add inner depth induction on K, (b) add 2-var agreement as hypothesis and prove it elsewhere, or (c) restructure as mutual induction.

continuation_context.key_insight: The non-between zones (eq_t, eq_x, below_t, above_x) and the forward between_tx all need the very 2-var agreement that nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses is constructing. The zone3_from_bracket quantifier needs 3-var agreement. These are all instances of the same circularity: building n-var agreement from 1-var agreements requires (n-1)-var agreement which is not available as a hypothesis. Breaking this requires either: (1) a joint induction on depth K and arity, (2) splitting the theorem to separate the between_tx case from the rest, or (3) adding the 2-var agreement as an explicit hypothesis (and proving it by induction elsewhere).
